purpose: Default format for requirements documents when no project-specific format exists: additive feature frontmatter, requirement ID catalog, body template, and a severity catalog for violations.
summary: Additive feature frontmatter with feature_type temporary-feature, applied only when the change qualifies as an additive feature
Four points the feature_note must state, with the frontmatter SoT referenced
Requirement ID catalog of prefixes such as APP, SCR, FNC, BL, DM, API, NFR, SEC, ERR and GLS
Body template with title, glossary line, overview, prerequisites, requirement list and open items
Requirement list subsections for display requirements, operation requirements, and error cases
Open items table with TBD IDs and deadlines
Severity catalog serving as the SoT for review severity, which criteria must not judge
Missing frontmatter on an additive feature requirements document is major, with exclusions to prevent false positives
tasks: Deciding whether to add additive feature frontmatter
Judging severity of requirements review findings
title: 要件定義書 デフォルトフォーマット
